jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Onboarding
jobs.description:
About PayJoy
 
PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.
 
This role


As Director of Product Management, Onboarding, you will lead a team of four product managers responsible for one of the most critical parts of PayJoy's business: the journey that brings customers to originate a loan.
You will own the vision for the end-to-end onboarding experience across both digital and in-store channels, with digital as an increasingly important focus for the team. As PayJoy expands, you will play a key role in launching new countries, guiding the strategic decisions of where to build global, scalable solutions versus where to localize for specific markets.
Your teams will span:
Application — Optimizing for a fast, transparent digital application that adheres to local regulation in every market we serve.
Direct-to-Consumer — Building fully digital acquisition journeys that don't begin in a physical store, a fast-growing channel for PayJoy.
Enterprise — Building digital solutions that empower our partners to onboard more customers with PayJoy, turning those relationships into a powerful engine for growth.
Offers/Risk — Refining how offers are presented and bringing in new data sources that let us underwrite customers who are newer to credit or have thinner credit histories.

Responsibilities
Vision & strategy

-
Define and drive the multi-year product strategy for PayJoy's onboarding experience.

-
Capitalize on incoming customer demand by designing personalized, high-converting onboarding journeys across digital and in-store channels.

-
Set the strategy for launching onboarding in new countries as PayJoy expands — deciding where to build global, scalable solutions versus where to localize for specific markets.

-
Identify opportunities to extend onboarding beyond loan origination — including pre-qualification, cross-sell at the point of application, and reactivation of returning customers.

Team leadership & delivery

-
Lead, coach, and grow a team of four product managers, setting a high quality bar and empowering them to own end-to-end delivery across their surfaces — from discovery and prioritization through launch and iteration.

-
Set the direction and standards for application flow, data architecture, performance, and UX consistency across digital and in-store channels, and hold the team accountable to them.

-
Establish the operating rhythm and prioritization framework your team uses to make sharp trade-offs and ship with both quality and speed.

-
Ensure onboarding launches in new markets land quickly and compliantly, guiding the team's build-global-versus-localize decisions and holding the bar on regulatory requirements in every market.

Cross-functional leadership

-
Partner deeply with Engineering leadership to align on architecture decisions, build out onboarding best practices, and scale onboarding capacity.

-
Own key business KPIs such as conversion rate through the onboarding funnel and cost per approved customer.

-
Ensure onboarding investments accelerate core revenue to the business.

-
Influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations to align on priorities and trade-offs.
Qualifications
-

-
8+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or staff-level role.

-
Demonstrated experience building and scaling consumer products — ideally at a company that's gone through a period of rapid growth or a platform inflection point.

-
Deep expertise across the customer journey: acquisition and onboarding funnels, conversion optimization, and the data infrastructure that supports them.

-
Strong background in fintech or consumer financial services preferred

-
Proven ability to translate ambiguous strategic goals into clear roadmaps, sharp prioritization decisions, and measurable outcomes.

-
Ability to drive the analytical measurement of the team — ensuring the right instrumentation is in place to build dashboards, track performance, and continuously monitor the health of the product.

-
Experience leading and inspiring product teams, managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders at significant scale.

-
Exceptional cross-functional influencer across engineering, design, data, risk, and operations — without relying on formal authority.

-
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

-
Experience with platform-level product architecture — particularly secured/unsecured or credit lifecycle product models.

-
Background in emerging markets, LATAM, or building products for underbanked consumer segments.

-
Hands-on experience with conversion optimization, growth loops, or customer data platforms and communication tooling.

-
SQL fluency or equivalent ability to self-serve product insights from data.
Benefits
- 100% Company-funded Health and dental and vision discount plan for employees and immediate family members.

- Life insurance.

- Phone finance, Headphone, home office equipment and wellness perks.

- 30 days of Christmas bonus

- 20 days paid Vacation

- 50% Vacation premium

- 13% Saving funds

- $2,000 MXN monthly grocery coupons

- $2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk

- $2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk

- Catered lunches
PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
 
PayJoy Principles
 
Finance for the next billion * Ownership * Break Through Walls * Live Communication * Transparency & Directness * Focus on Scale * Work-Life Balance * Embrace Diversity * Speed * Active Listening

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Mobile Product
jobs.description:
About PayJoy
 
PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.
 
This role


Principal Product Manager, Mobile
Location: San Francisco, United States | Mexico City, Mexico Reports to: SVP of Product Management
About PayJoy
PayJoy is a mission-first fintech company dedicated to bringing financial access to the next billion people in emerging markets. Our patented technology turns a smartphone into collateral, giving unbanked consumers an on-ramp to credit. We've served over 20 million customers across 11 markets and remain strongly profitable — and we're just getting started.
We're now at an inflection point: evolving PayJoy from a transactional loan app into a financial hub spanning credit, e-commerce, benefits, and beyond. This role is central to driving that transformation.
The Role
As Principal Product Manager, Mobile, you will own the vision, architecture, and execution of transforming PayJoy's apps into a destination our customers want to return to.
This is a senior Individual Contributor role reporting to the SVP of Product Management. You'll work directly with Engineering leadership and the executive team to shape PayJoy's next chapter.
What You'll Do
Platform vision & strategy
Define and drive the multi-year product strategy for PayJoy's mobile app platform.
PayJoy operates a portfolio of multiple consumer and in-store apps. You'll help define how these apps fit together as one coherent ecosystem.
Determine which capabilities live in which app, how customers discover and move from one app to the next, and how we handle deep links and handoffs, consistent navigation, and a shared design system across surfaces.
Capitalize on active user traffic by designing personalized cross-sell capabilities across the ecosystem.
Identify opportunities to extend the platform beyond servicing — including e-commerce, rewards and benefits ecosystems, and engagement tools.
Develop the strategy for embedding financial education into the app, appropriate for a low-financial-literacy customer base.
Execution & delivery
Own end-to-end product delivery: from discovery and prioritization through development, launch, and post-launch iteration across all app surfaces.
Define platform-level standards for navigation, architecture, performance, and UX consistency across all apps.
Establish and run the mobile release process and cadence across the app portfolio — coordinating feature freezes, code cutoffs, regression windows, and coordinated cross-app releases where changes span multiple apps.
Own the end-to-end submission process for Google Play, including review timelines and rejections/appeals, metadata and content-rating requirements, and keeping releases compliant with store policies.
Drive phased and staged rollouts, feature-flagging and remote config, beta/internal testing tracks (Play internal/closed testing), forced- and recommended-update strategy, and rollback/hotfix procedures when something goes wrong in production.
Drive PayJoy's app store presence — owning store optimization (ASO), ratings and reviews management, and release strategy on Google Play.
Cross-functional leadership
Partner deeply with Engineering leadership to align on architecture decisions, build out native mobile best practices, and scale platform capacity.
Own key business KPIs such as cross-sell and reduced CX contacts per active user.
Ensure platform investments accelerate core revenue to the business.
Influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations to align on platform priorities and trade-offs.
What You'll Bring
Required
8+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or staff-level role.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling consumer mobile apps — ideally at a company that's gone through a platform inflection point.
Deep expertise in Android product development: navigation patterns, mobile architecture, performance, release management, and app store operations.
Strong background in fintech, consumer financial services, or a similarly regulated, data-intensive domain.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous strategic goals into clear roadmaps, sharp prioritization decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated capability to define instrumentation events, execute phased rollouts, and measure metrics.
Exceptional cross-functional influencer across engineering, design, data, risk, and operations — without relying on formal authority.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.
Nice to have
Experience managing a multi-app or platform-level product portfolio — particularly secured/unsecured or credit-lifecycle product models.
Background in emerging markets, LATAM, or building products for underbanked consumer segments.
Hands-on experience with app store optimization, growth loops, or engagement and retention product mechanics.
SQL fluency or equivalent ability to self-serve product insights from data.
Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

This role


Job Summary
PayJoy Lock is the core moat of PayJoy's business, a proprietary security stack running across the world's largest emerging market device fleet.
 
As PM for Lock Platform, you will own the programs that keep that moat strong and expanding. You will combine deep technical fluency with strategic clarity to drive lock security, reliability, and device compatibility programs across multiple markets.
 
This is a key Individual Contributor role reporting to the Lock Platform Lead. You will work alongside a team of engineers helping to increase PayJoy's lock strength, expand device selection, and reduce fraud and accidental locking across multiple emerging markets.
 
This role is based in our San Francisco office. We are an in-person team and expect this role to be in office
Key Responsibilities
Execution & Delivery
 
Own end-to-end delivery of lock platform initiatives — from problem definition through launch, post-launch iteration, and ongoing operational ownership.
Drive lock security initiatives including OTA enforcement, device vulnerability reduction, and the systems that give leadership real-time visibility into platform health.
Lead the lock reliability program — own the framework that prevents accidental locking incidents and ensures policy compliance across every new feature shipped.
Own device compatibility programs — track where PayJoy has gaps, launch new locking technology to close them, and ensure every device PayJoy finances meets the security bar.
Support new market and country launches — own the lock readiness checklist and ensure no new market goes live without meeting the bar.
Cross-Functional Leadership
 
Manage cross-functional execution with engineering, GTM, legal, OEM partners, and field teams — with proactive communication and clear ownership of timelines and deliverables.
Represent the lock platform in cross-functional forums 
Review and synthesize competitive intelligence from field analysts and in-market research to inform roadmap decisions.
Communicate progress proactively to leadership — status, risks, and decisions surface.
Required Skills & Qualifications
 
8+ years as a Product Manager with a track record of owning technically complex programs end-to-end — PRD through launch through post-launch iteration — without hand-holding.
Technical fluency on Android or mobile platforms — able to engage directly with engineers on implementation details, debug issues, and make informed tradeoff decisions.
Independently frames problems, proposes solutions with explicit tradeoffs, leads cross-functional execution, and surfaces risk proactively without being asked.
Experience in mobile security, device management, OEM ecosystems, or adjacent technically complex domains.
Strong analytical ability — can query data independently, build metrics frameworks, and own product health visibility..
Preferred Skills & Qualifications
 
Experience with Android lock mechanisms, Knox, or device enrollment technologies.
Familiarity with OTA update processes and OEM certification workflows.
Experience launching products in or for emerging markets (LATAM, SEA, Africa).
Hybrid PM/engineer background — comfortable reading code, reviewing PRs, contributing to technical specifications.
SQL fluency or equivalent ability to self-serve product insights from data.
Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Trust and Safety
jobs.description:
PayJoy is a mission-driven, mission-first company dedicated to helping a billion people around the world step into the modern financial system for the first time and supporting them on a path to financial success.  Founded in 2015, PayJoy’s “secret sauce” technology turns a smartphone into collateral to jumpstart unbanked consumers into the credit system.  We reached profitability in 2019 and are growing rapidly, reaching over a billion dollars of sales in 2022 from millions of happy customers.
About the Role
The Senior Product Manager for Trust & Safety will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of fraud prevention and detection across PayJoy’s global platforms. This is not a back-office risk role—it’s a high-visibility product leadership position at the intersection of AI, data science, security, and customer experience. You’ll build the intelligent systems that protect millions of first-time smartphone owners in emerging markets from fraud—including increasingly AI-powered attack vectors—while ensuring that legitimate customers never feel the friction. You’ll partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Operations, and country GMs to ship ML-powered detection, AI-driven decisioning agents, and frictionless identity verification—directly shaping PayJoy’s ability to scale responsibly into new markets.
Who you are
The ideal candidate combines deep fraud/risk product experience with genuine technical fluency—someone who can evaluate ML model performance, see where AI agents can automate fraud triage and investigation, and still keep the customer experience front and center. You thrive in ambiguity, can sequence competing priorities across multiple geographies, and communicate fraud posture and strategic tradeoffs to senior leadership with clarity and conviction. Above all, you believe that financial inclusion and world-class fraud prevention aren’t at odds—they’re the same mission.
Key Responsibilities
-
Define and drive a multi-market Trust & Safety strategy that balances fraud loss reduction with customer conversion—owning the full roadmap from detection accuracy improvements to false-positive reduction and friction minimization.

-
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle—from problem discovery through launch and iteration—for fraud detection and prevention systems across all PayJoy markets.

-
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ship ML-powered decisioning, AI-driven investigation agents, rule engines, real-time monitoring, and alerting tools that adapt to evolving fraud vectors.

-
Design frictionless fraud mitigation experiences (identity verification, step-up authentication, device intelligence) that protect users without punishing them.

-
Identify and prioritize emerging fraud patterns across markets—identity fraud, device manipulation, synthetic identities, AI-generated deepfakes, and agentic attacks—before they scale.

-
Explore and champion the use of AI and agentic automation to scale fraud operations—automated case triage, adaptive rule tuning, intelligent alert routing—so PayJoy can operate lean fraud ops teams across dozens of markets.

-
Define and own key Trust & Safety metrics (loss rates, false positive rates, detection latency, customer impact scores) and build dashboards that make fraud posture visible company-wide.

-
Run experimentation frameworks to measure the real-world tradeoff between fraud prevention tightening and customer conversion impact.

-
Be the connective tissue between Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Ops, Legal, Compliance, and country GMs—ensuring alignment on fraud tolerance, policy, and customer experience. Communicate risks and roadmap tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Requierments
-
6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years focused on fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments within fintech or a regulated, high-scale platform.

-
Proven track record of shipping fraud prevention or risk management products that measurably reduced losses without killing conversion.

-
Strong technical fluency—you can hold your own in conversations about ML model performance, AI/LLM applications in fraud, API design, data pipelines, and real-time decisioning systems.

-
Hands-on data skills: you write SQL, build dashboards, and use data to drive every major decision.

-
Experience driving cross-functional execution with engineering, data science, operations, and compliance teams in a fast-paced, global environment.

-
Exceptional prioritization instincts—you know how to sequence work across multiple markets and competing urgencies.
Additional Bonus Skills
-
Experience with fraud in emerging markets (Latin America, Africa, or Southeast Asia)—where fraud patterns, data availability, and infrastructure look very different from the US/EU.

-
Familiarity with fraud prevention tools and vendors (e.g., Sift, Arkose Labs, Sardine, or equivalent).

-
Background in device intelligence, behavioral biometrics, or identity verification technologies.

-
Prior experience building or integrating ML-based fraud detection models (you don’t need to train them—but you should know how to evaluate and improve them).

-
Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM agents to fraud operations workflows—automated investigation, intelligent case routing, or generative risk scoring.

-
Knowledge of compliance regulations related to fraud (e.g., AML, KYC).

-
Fluency in Spanish.

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.
 
This role


PayJoy is expanding access to smartphone financing and digital credit globally. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to help launch and scale our financial products—including phone finance, credit line, card, and new initiatives like Super Pacman and Super Monarch—across existing and new markets in LATAM and South Africa.
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Design, and GTM/country teams. You will own delivery governance for product launches across your markets: roadmap, dependencies, execution cadence, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration, partnering with regional and global Product leads.
You'll act as the connective tissue between global product teams and local markets, ensuring local requirements are properly scoped, prioritized, built, tested, and successfully deployed. You'll also build the playbooks, processes, and documentation that let PayJoy scale launches efficiently and compliantly across regions.

Responsibilities
Program Oversight & Execution

-
Own the end-to-end planning and execution for launching PayJoy's financial products in LATAM and South African markets.

-
Develop comprehensive project plans covering product definition, legal contracts, rollout strategy, and feature delivery timelines.

-
Translate business and market requirements into clearly defined product and engineering deliverables.

-
Partner with Product Managers to define MVP scope and success criteria.

-
Maintain RAID log, decision log, and dependency map; run weekly execution reviews and milestone tracking.

-
Drive sprint planning visibility for market-critical epics and unblock teams to hit milestones.

Engineering & Systems Coordination

-
Work closely with Engineering to ensure backend systems, APIs, integrations, and configurations are ready for launch.

-
Coordinate delivery of market-specific requirements (e.g., KYC flows, repayment logic, partner integrations, underwriting configurations) across geographies.

-
Own the production readiness checklist: monitoring, logging, alerting, runbooks, on-call coverage, and escalation paths for launch.

-
Coordinate readiness with local partners and vendors (KYC, lender, payments, collections) including certifications, SLAs, and integration timelines.

Testing & Launch Readiness

-
Lead UAT, Friendly Sales testing, and pilot rollout or limited-market launch.

-
Define test plans and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product and QA; develop and manage test case lists.

-
Track defects, prioritize fixes, and ensure issues are resolved before go-live.

-
Run launch readiness reviews with go/no-go criteria, including rollback and incident response readiness.

Documentation & Compliance

-
Build and maintain a detailed Product Launch Playbook covering country/product combinations, so launches become repeatable and efficient across regions.

-
Partner with Legal and Risk to gather local regulatory requirements and define product customizations for each market.

-
Ensure all legal decisions, inputs, and audits are properly documented (e.g., in JIRA) and traceable.

Design & Localization Coordination

-
Collaborate with Product Managers on feature backlogs and technical requirements, helping prioritize as needed.

-
Partner with Design to ensure localized and translated assets and approvals are completed prior to launch.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Communication

-
Serve as the primary technical program lead across Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Design, Operations, and country teams.

-
Facilitate structured working sessions to align on priorities and resolve trade-offs.

-
Provide weekly written updates to leadership (and Product Review updates) using a standard template covering status, risks, decisions needed, and timeline health.

-
Maintain a scope change log and drive trade-off decisions using DACI or RACI.

Post-Launch Optimization

-
Establish dashboards to monitor product performance post-launch (approvals, conversion, repayment performance, incident rate, error rate, latency, and funnel drop-off reasons).

-
Partner with Product and Data to identify performance gaps, define a learning agenda, and build the iteration roadmap.

-
Support rapid experimentation and UX/UI improvements following MVP release, tracking enhancements accordingly.
Qualifications
- 6+ years of experience in technical program management, ideally in fintech or lending.

-
Strong technical fluency, comfortable driving API contracts, integration sequencing, observability requirements, and release governance.

-
Experience launching 0→1 products in new markets or new verticals.

-
Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional initiatives with multiple technical dependencies.

-
Experience building repeatable playbooks, processes, and documentation that let launches scale.

-
Comfortable partnering with Legal and Risk on regulatory requirements and market-specific product customizations.

-
Highly organized, with strong written communication and stakeholder management skills.

-
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving execution in fast-paced environments.

Strong bias for written communication and structured execution (RAID, milestones), and driving alignment across markets and time zones.

Fluency in English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese strongly preferred for LATAM markets. Experience working with global teams across multiple geographies a plus.
